verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework for building your own agents. Studio is described as an interface for building, testing and managing agents that developers create, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to. The single passing mention of 'Mastra Code' does not describe a built-in assistant inside the product, so the evidence does not support this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
